newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK INFLATION FELL BELOW 6.0PCT Y/Y IN APRIL - MIN.
newsitem.headline: GREEK INFLATION FELL BELOW 6.0PCT Y/Y IN APRIL - MIN.

text.p: Greek consumer price inflation fell below 6.0 percent year-on-year in April, tax revenues have recovered and the budget is being implemented as planned, said National Economy Minister Yannos Papandoniou.
"Inflation fell below 6.0 percent in April, tax revenues have recovered impressively, the budget is being implemented and the absorption of EU funds is proceeding positively," said Papandoniou.
He was speaking after meeting with Prime Minister Costas Simitis to discuss the economy.

Papandoniou added that the balance of payments could end up being better than Bank of Greece figures indicated because of improved trade balance figures compiled by the National Statistics Service (NSS).
